faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in date for DSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Assistant Professor in Chemistry will be held on Tuesday, 03.11.2026 & 02:00 pm.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the DSC Assistant Professor walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled at Dyal Singh College (University of Delhi), Lodhi Road, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Chemistry?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Chemistry department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the category-wise break-up of Chemistry vacancies?
faq.answer: The vacancies include अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (ओबीसी/OBC)-1, अनारक्षित अनुसूचित जाति/ Scheduled Caste-1, अनुसूचित जनजाति/ Scheduled Tribe-1, अनारक्षित (यूआर/UR) – 1, and (ईडब्ल्यूएस/EWS) - 1.

faq.question: Q5. What documents are required to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a copy of their bio-data/CV, along with original testimonials and copies of documents in support of their application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of appointment for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions are for Assistant Professor on a guest basis through walk-in interviews.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to attend the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates (as per the above categories) who fulfill all the latest eligibility requirements of University/UGC norms may come for the interviews.

faq.question: Q8. Can the number of vacancies change?
faq.answer: Yes, the numbers and nature of posts may vary (more or less and provisional, subject to change) depending upon the workload requirements of department.
